meta.title: Vaivém — Send USDC with a link
meta.description: Create walletless payouts that recipients can claim on Stellar or withdraw through regional payment rails such as PIX.

nav.addFundsFirst: Add funds on the Funding page before creating a claim.

custody.line: Demo ledger on a shared sponsor wallet — not segregated custody.

errors.request_failed: Could not send the code. Try again.

landing.heroTitle: Send money. They cash out to their bank.
landing.heroBody: Share a link over WhatsApp. Your recipient opens it, claims the payout, and withdraws to PIX in minutes — no wallet, no app install.
landing.heroAside: No wallet installs · Cash out in minutes
landing.footerBlurb: Walletless USDC payouts on Stellar, with local cash-out through rails like PIX. Built for Latin America.
landing.footerLegal: © {year} Vaivém. Not a bank. USDC is issued by Circle.
landing.problemTitle: A payer abroad. A recipient in Brazil. Three days of friction.
landing.problemBody: Wire fees, intermediary banks, and “please send your IBAN again” — while someone waits for money that should already be theirs.
landing.flowBody: One phone. As each step comes into view, the screen advances.
landing.flowStep1Body: Fund a payout and share it on WhatsApp, email, or QR. Optional email or access-code protection.
landing.flowStep2Body: No account creation. They confirm who they are and see the amount in reais.
landing.flowStep3Body: They enter a PIX key and withdraw to their bank. Settlement typically lands in minutes.
landing.phoneUnlockBody: Enter the code from your email to unlock this payout.
landing.phonePixBody: Paste your PIX key. Money goes to your bank account.
landing.phoneDoneBody: Your bank should credit the PIX shortly.
landing.kitTitle: Twelve lines. A payout anyone can claim.
landing.kitBody: Call the API with a Bearer key. We handle escrow, FX, and the recipient experience — including PIX cash-out.
landing.kitNote: Technical rails use USDC on Stellar under the hood. Recipients never have to know.
landing.proofBody: Sandbox numbers we measure against every day. Production availability follows the provider.
landing.corridorNote: Provider availability shifts without notice. BRL on-ramp was 424 FailedToGetQuote on 2026-08-05 and returned 200 on 2026-08-06 (SPIKE.md). BRL off-ramp quotes fail at every amount as of 2026-08-06. Treat corridor status as runtime data, not a permanent product claim.
landing.ctaBody: Create a protected claim link in under a minute. Your recipient opens it like any other WhatsApp message.

funding.title: Funding
funding.sandboxBody: Two ways to fund: fiat on-ramp (BRL / MXN, max {max}) or send Etherfuse USDC on Stellar testnet with your memo. Credits reconcile on every page load.
funding.fiatBody: Creates a live Etherfuse on-ramp order. After it completes, you go straight to Create.
funding.amountHint: 1–{max} {currency} · sandbox cap applies to both currencies
funding.pixCopyTitle: Pix copia e cola — pay from your banking app
funding.pixQrHint: Pix QR — scan in your banking app
funding.statusPageHint: Payment instructions are not in the API response. Open the Etherfuse order page and tap Get Transfer Details. In sandbox that modal shows the amount but no Pix copia-e-cola — use Etherfuse sandbox tools to simulate fiat receipt, then return here.
funding.statusQrHint: QR opens the order page — not a Pix code for your bank app
funding.pendingBody: Orders waiting on Etherfuse. Status is refreshed on every page load; use Check status after completing payment in the sandbox.
funding.usdcBody: For DAOs and treasuries that already hold USDC. Send to the sponsor address with your unique memo — credits appear after Horizon sees the payment.
funding.otherUsdcIgnored: Payments in any other USDC (different issuer) are ignored and will not be credited.
funding.addressQrHint: QR encodes the Stellar address — set memo type Hash and paste the hex in your wallet before sending.

developers.title: Developers
developers.headline: Payouts infrastructure for builders
developers.body: Send money to anyone with one API call. We handle escrow, FX, compliance, and the recipient experience — you ship faster.
developers.apiBody: Create claim links with a Bearer API key. Amount is USDC; currency is the recipient display currency. Get keys in the dashboard.

apiKeys.listBody: Active keys can create and read claims for your account.
